name: 主界面精修
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup / precise compositing refinement.
Produce ONE beautifully polished FULL-SCREEN GAME UI hero mockup, landscape16:9, for the selected "35 Pocket Fieldkit / 口袋观察站" design for Little Elsewhere. This is a refinement of an APPROVED interface, not a new visual direction or a collage of alternatives.
INPUT IMAGE1: locked ORIGINAL outdoor background. Preserve this image's composition, colors, daylight, spatial relationships and painterly pixel scenery as closely as possible; no repainting/restyling/rearranging any tree, birds, snow mountains, river, town, right house, curved shoreline, balcony railing, plants, cup, green book or food tray. Insert it as the background and only add interface overlays.
INPUT IMAGE2: SELECTED UI35 STYLE REFERENCE. Retain its friendly Japanese pixel field-kit aesthetic and its five-tool interaction structure. Improve polish, spacing, visual hierarchy, consistency and icon craft. Do NOT adopt monochrome GameBoy LCD, art deco, textile, origami, skeuomorphic metal, heavy decorative frames or generic rounded app cards.

Final coherent UI palette: warm cream #FAF6E8, deep moss ink #384235, olive #7F9255, selected pale leaf #D7E3AA, dusty blue #6D8796, very small warm gold #D4A65C. Crisp 2px-grid stepped corners, fine dark 1–2px contour, 1px warm inner highlight, just 2px downward pixel shadow. Tiny dots only within panels if any, no messy grain. Pixelart icons professionally designed at24–32px with coherent pixel scale, 4–5colors per icon: binoculars, seed scoop, open field notebook, four-point phenomenon sparkle, headphones. Chinese labels crystal-clear clean text, bitmap-style numbers; do not sacrifice Chinese readability for jagged text.

Composition inside actual full 16:9 game viewport:
1. Upper-left small single slim weather/date chip around230×42 logicalpixels, tiny sun/cloud pixel icon, short text "春 · 第12日 08:20". Remove giant title banner.
2. Upper-right two well-aligned compact chips: tiny bird icon "来访 3", little book icon "图鉴 12/50". A tiny speaker control can sit beside them, no dashboard.
3. Lower-center, above the bottom edge and aligned over the wooden sill: an elegant compact row of FIVE individual square-stepped keycaps with pixelicons above text, in this order "观察" "投喂" "图鉴" "奇遇" "陪伴". Each roughly84×60 logicalpx, uniform8pxgaps, small subtle1–5shortcut hints bottomcorner. Observe is SELECTED: pale leaf fill, stronger olive innerstroke, small downward marker. Otherkeycapswarmcream, slateink. Toolbelt coherent and tactileyetlight, totalwidth~480–520px NOT fullscreenwidth. Respect original book/cup, no huge plates.
4. At right edge a narrow recent visitor strip of only THREE stacked32pxbirdavatar squares, with one tiny newbadge, max110pxtall. No permanent profile pane.
5. One delicately anchored tiny sparrow observation label pointing to the EXISTING low tree-branch bird: "麻雀 · 来访3次" and five little familiarity squares 3 filled, a subtle "已记录" check. Keep label close tobird, away frommiddleofmountains. Pixelcream speechbubblewithshorttail. Newdiscovery dot not hugeNEWbanner.
6. Lower-left a small unobtrusive feeding status capsule "鸟食 68%" with3seedicondots and a tiny plus; noopenfeedingwindow by default. Feed popover CLOSED in this hero; other detailboards show it.
No guide or giant popover open in this idle hero. Main HUD around8–10%ofviewportedges. River center and mountain silhouette remain open and dominant. Interface must feel inviting and COMPLETE, not simplistic baretextbuttons.
No design-board bottom strip, no palette swatches, no debug toolbar, no software chrome, no external header. A polished main gameplay screen as it could ship, using the approved UI35 system with careful craftsmanship. No full-screen tint, fog overlay, pixelization or change of background style. Do not add new objects, birds or fictional scenery.

refinement_prompt:
Precise localized UI refinement of the supplied game mockup. Change ONLY the large sparrow observation speech bubble near upper-middle. Keep the entire scenery, window frame, tree, birds, branches, mountains, river, houses, balcony, props, all toolbar buttons, weather/date labels, counters, visitor avatars and feeding status EXACTLY unchanged.

The present speech bubble is too wide and crosses the mountain silhouette. Replace it with a compact two-line pixel UI callout about HALF its current width (~230–250px on this1672px image), positioned immediately above and slightly LEFT of the selected low-branch sparrow, tucked close to the tree. The short pointed tail must still point to that same sparrow. Top line short clear Chinese "麻雀 · 来访3次". Bottom line exactly five familiarity square pips, three filled olive and two empty, plus one tiny green checkmark; remove the long "已记录" words from this tooltip. Cream #FAF6E8 fill, deep moss #384235 1–2px stepped border, tiny lower pixel shadow and consistent lettering. No tooltip overlapping the open central skyline. Preserve its delicate UI35 PocketFieldkit style. Change NOTHING else. Same16:9full-screen composition, no added design-board frame or header.
